mindnote.heroSubtitle: Your notes, your ideas and your team — in one fluid workspace.
mindnote.mockupBlock3: Your team meets on the same page.
mindnote.statementBody: MindNote weaves your notes into a network. Jump from one idea to the next in a click, and watch your map grow with your knowledge.
mindnote.feature1Body: Text, headings, lists — everything is a block. Drag, move, restructure.
mindnote.feature2Body: Build your own knowledge graph with note-to-note links. Your mind map emerges on its own.
mindnote.feature3Body: Organise personal spaces and invite your team with a code. Everyone works from one source.
mindnote.feature4Body: Automatically track workplace-safety legislation from the Official Gazette. Important changes come to you.
mindnote.ctaBody: MindNote runs in your browser. Sign up and create your first note in seconds.
